title: Fastned - Volvo C40 Recharge 78 kWh (2021-2023) charge graph
notes: Charge graph embedded in the Fastned vehicle page (C40 Recharge 78 kWh (2021 - 2023), charger class 150+), one kW value per SoC %, read with curl. Page carries no reuse terms and the Fastned terms of use have no clause on vehicle chart data (owner confirms). Fastned says curves assume a battery near 30 C.
